correctness.resource_note: Bounded corpus reports measure the conformance driver. Each corpus report separately records the maximum per-file worker RSS; these maxima must not be conflated.

comparisons.note: ABBA uses the mean of two process medians per source. Separation is descriptive, not a significance test. Actual binding ratios use separate single-process measurements.

diagnostics.note: Untimed source-paired complete outcomes and current physical/index-probe signatures match across runtimes. Actual comparison-list identity hits plus fewer original key_comparisons calls prove repeated-probe reuse. Singleton cases do not prepare structures. Private plan/access copies start at probe zero; successful preparation occurs at probe two. Exact-ceiling cost outcomes remain API-specific and are preserved verbatim. Secondary/composite coverage uses a private small fixture, while main benchmark SQL remains unchanged.

cross.note: One fresh process per core; median of five samples. Cross-core checks rendered-value checksums/row counts, not exact costs/metadata. Existing collectors differ; exact binding verification is separate.

profiles.note: execute_prepared with the existing eager collector. All timings precede tracing. Allocations and call counts are diagnostic observations, not sampled CPU-time attribution.

harness_smoke.note: Before/final untimed YJIT fixture smokes precede formal pins. They may precede full correctness checks; formal measurements still follow all completed correctness workers.

smoke_correction.explanation: Diagnostic method-level ensure referenced sessions defined only inside a nested block; initialize cleanup locals before iteration.
smoke_correction.note: The original helper referenced a block-local variable from a method ensure. Initializing that cleanup local was the only helper change; both sources then completed successfully.
